name: Unsent's toolbox
description:
This ToolBox is used in Psych Engine 1.0.4 or 0.6.2.
C - Toggle Botplay    V - Toggle Practice Mode
N - Add Scroll Speed 0.1 (Hold Shift to +0.5)
M - Reduce Scroll Speed 0.1 (Hold Shift to -0.5)
*If you installed this mod in Psych Engine 1.0.4, then check the Mod settings and enable the "Psych Engine 1.0.4 Mode"! *
